It fits tasks about updating online profiles, taking ID/passport photos, or framing portraits, though at tiny sizes the circle-and-arc inside a square can resemble a sun-over-hill landscape picture icon.

pass1.ambiguity: At small sizes it can look like a generic landscape photo icon (sun over a hill) or a washing machine / speaker box.
